card.name: Local rules in disposal instructions
card.fires_on: The word "local" (or the word right after it, like requirements or regulations) in phrases such as "dispose of in accordance with local requirements". Also fires once inside the word coumarin.

modes.label: Local disposal rules
modes.description: "local" or the noun after it, ending a disposal instruction for needles, syringes or unused product.
modes.example: Dispose of any unused medicinal product or waste material in accordance with<< local>> requirements.

modes.label: Inside coumarin
modes.description: The middle piece of the drug-class word coumarin in an anticoagulant interaction sentence.
modes.example: Physicians should monitor PT and INR more frequently in patients concurrently administered ZOLINZA and cou<<mar>>in derivatives.

card.plain: It marks the phrase "in accordance with local requirements" at the end of instructions on throwing away used needles and leftover product.
